selection.ownership: BigML, Inc., a Delaware corporation with offices at 2851 NW 9th Street, Suite D, Corvallis, Oregon 97330, United States (European office in Valencia, Spain). The reviewed edition is the public international API at https://bigml.io/andromeda, not a mainland-China product and not a private/VPC BigML deployment.

research.searchCoverage: Official BigML.io Andromeda API (username and api_key query parameters, GET /model, GET /model/{id}, GET /prediction, GET /prediction/{id}), credential help, Corvallis/US identity, private-deployment note distinguished from the public host, and dated incident search for BigML security breach/incident reviewed on 2026-09-13. No qualifying current unresolved BigML customer-account compromise identified; this is not a breach-free claim.

Official public API at https://bigml.io/andromeda with username and api_key query authentication, GET /model?limit=1 as the cheap authenticated model list used by the pinned credential validator (not a billed prediction), model and prediction list/get reads, Corvallis identity, and dated 2026-09-13 incident search. Private/VPC API servers are not exposed. Create/delete prediction writes are omitted. No current unresolved customer-account compromise identified. Bounded coverage is not a breach-free claim.
research.waiverAuthority: User waiver dated 2026-09-13 permits historical non-China incident coverage.

projects.create.title: Create project
projects.create.description: Create a BigML project via POST /project.

category.description: Category code for the project domain.

description.description: Description of the project up to 8192 characters.

external-connectors.create.title: Create external connector
external-connectors.create.description: Create a BigML external connector for PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL Server, or Elasticsearch via POST /externalconnector.

name.description: User-defined name for the external connector.

source.description: Type of the external data source. Defaults to postgresql on the server.

project.description: Project resource id in the form project/XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX.

connection.description: Connection details object for the chosen source type.

projects.delete.title: Delete project
projects.delete.description: Permanently delete a BigML project via DELETE /project/{projectId}. Pass the 24-character hex suffix, not the project/ prefix.

projectId.description: Project ID suffix to delete. Do not include the project/ prefix.

sources.update.title: Update source
sources.update.description: Update a BigML source's name, description, tags, fields, or parser via PUT /source/{sourceId}. Pass the 24-character hex suffix, not the source/ prefix.

sourceId.description: Source id without the source/ prefix.

fields.description: Field configurations keyed by field ID (e.g. '000001').

description.description: New description for the source (up to 8192 characters).

sourceParser.description: Parsing configuration (locale, missing_tokens, separator, quote). Maps to source_parser.
